description: This Java source file defines the ContainerConfig class, which manages container configurations in the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for retrieving configurations, parsing XML elements, and handling container properties.

classes.name: ContainerConfig
classes.description: Manages container configurations, providing methods to retrieve and parse container configuration data from XML elements.

classes.name: ContainerConfig.Configuration
classes.description: Represents a container configuration, including its properties and associated metadata.

classes.name: ContainerConfig.Configuration.Property
classes.description: Represents a property within a container configuration, supporting nested properties and value filtering.

methods.name: getConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves a container configuration by name, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: getConfigurations
methods.description: Parses XML to find container configuration elements and stores them.

methods.name: getPropertyValue
methods.description: Retrieves property values from container properties, with overloads for String, int, and boolean types.
